sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Module purpose and imports
sections.what: States that this file holds equipment recipes whose sizes and layouts are editable assumptions, and brings in the maths and grouping tools it uses.

sections.name: equipment_template
sections.title: Picking a default shape from the asset name
sections.what: Looks at the last part of an asset's path and matches keywords such as transformer, breaker, tower or cable trench. It returns a default shape type and default size, and falls back to a plain box of 4 by 3 by 4 when nothing matches.
sections.why: Gives every imported equipment item a sensible starting shape before any real geometry is known. Likely reason: the source schedules do not provide shapes.
sections.watch_out: The keywords are checked in order and the first match wins, so reordering the list changes results. The keyword 'structure ' has a trailing space, so it only matches when another word follows it.

sections.name: wbs_layout
sections.title: Laying out assets on a conceptual grid
sections.what: Groups assets by their folder path, then arranges each group as a small grid of spaced tiles, and places the tiles in rows. The output is a rough planning layout, not real site positions.
sections.why: The docstring says this is a conceptual arrangement and must never be read as site coordinates. It exists so that assets are visible and do not overlap in the 3D view.
sections.watch_out: Spacing uses the largest width and depth in each group, so one large asset makes its whole group's grid wider and deeper.
